item.title: $19 million approved for three states by FEMA to help with recovery for past disasters
item.description: CHARLESTON, WV (WVNS) -- FEMA approved $19 million for West Virginia, Virginia, and Pennsylvania to aid with recovery for previous disasters. According to a press release, $19,585,828.05 was approved by FEMA, under President Trump and Secretary Noem's leadership, to help with recovery for Public Assistance projects in West Virginia, Virginia, and Pennsylvania for past disasters.
